title: Bear cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD98A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5A623'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#B5762E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#E8B36B'/>

  <ellipse cx='37' cy='89' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8C5A22'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='89' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8C5A22'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='88' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#E8B36B'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='88' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#E8B36B'/>

  <circle cx='32' cy='32' r='9' fill='#B5762E'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='9' fill='#B5762E'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='32' r='5' fill='#F0C98A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='5' fill='#F0C98A'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#B5762E'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#F0C98A'/>

  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#FFF3D6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3.4' ry='2.6' fill='#3A2208'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 55 Q50 59 54 55' stroke='#5A3410' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='74' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#B5762E' transform='rotate(20 28 74)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='56' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#B5762E' transform='rotate(-35 72 56)'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='6' fill='#8C5A22'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='3' fill='#E8B36B'/>
  <!-- little sparkle for wave -->
  <path d='M88 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z' fill='#FFE9A8'/>
